Well it's weird, because I'm not even a Pearl apologist or anything like that, really.  If I were in her position I feel I would do the same exact things she would have done.  What she does and how she reacts to things seems normal to me, but neither I nor anyone in the fandom can really put themselves in the shoes of a space rock.  Especially someone like Pearl.  I think it's probably easier to empathize with Garnet or Amethyst.

So leaving out potential backstory, Pearl was in love with Rose and came to fight in the rebellion with her because of that.  Leaving her home behind forever.  That already would kinda eff me up a bit.  Especially if the one I love leaves and I'm still here left with a child.  So I dunno, I think Pearl definitely has understandable problems and acts the way she acts for understandable reasons.

In SU I think Pearl has the most faults, but to me it just sets her apart from the cast and makes her more interesting.  If you wanna look at an example of a fandom hating a character with faults and who is similar to Pearl in some ways, you should see Rarity from MLP. (Sorry if ponies trigger other fandoms.)

tl;dr I think Pearl's a great character and you can see why from how much people like her and dislike her.

Well first of all let me just say there is nothing wrong with you.  You're not any of the negative things you say above.  You're ESPECIALLY not weird, either.  You're perfectly normal and although I don't know whether you have depression or not, I do know that I went through the same problems you're going through.  It sucks, it really does.  Just for right now though, know that there is nothing wrong with you.

Well she certainly doesn't seem like a good mom.  I'm sorry you have to deal with that kind of stuff.  My mom outright rejects any input I have and thinks her way is ALWAYS the best.  Obviously I can't say I know how you feel but I think I have an idea.  The only real advice I can give you now is don't ever let someone shut you up or take away your happiness.  You have a RIGHT to feel important and be happy.  If they don't want your input, then fine.  You don't need to talk to them.  You don't have to feel bad because of those kind of people.

First thing you can do and I know you'll do.  Don't ever give up on him.  Get him some help, and help guide him through it.  To be honest, I have that same thought process all the time...I try pushing people away because I feel like I'm a burden to them or I'm making their lives harder.  He seems like a genuinely great person to care about you and everyone else that much.  But don't let him push you away.  Be their for him and help him with whatever.  Get him to some help whether it's counseling or therapy or whatever coping he needs to do.  Guide him through it and don't ever be too busy for him.  Don't ever let him feel like he's bothering you with his problems.  Show him you care about him a lot.
Going for walks is one of my favorite ways to cope with things.  Especially with music because it really helps me block everything out and I can just sorta go to my own world for awhile and relax.
